### Bio:

I am a second-year M.S. student in Biostatistics at UCLA. Before coming to UCLA, I studied Statistics and Economics at the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign. My academic interests include biostatistics, genetics, neuroimaging, and women’s health research. I enjoy using data to better understand health-related questions. Outside of academics, I enjoy traveling, visiting cafés, and taking my dog on little adventures to different dog parks.
